### How it works

This workflow runs every six hours to monitor active n8n workflows. It lists published workflows, excludes the monitor workflow itself, then loops through each remaining workflow to fetch its definition and recent execution history. After all workflows are assessed, it builds a health report and sends a Telegram alert only when issues are detected.

### Setup steps

- Configure the n8n credentials used by the n8n nodes so they can list workflows, retrieve workflow details, and read executions from the target instance.
- Confirm the schedule trigger interval is appropriate for your monitoring needs.
- Update the exclusion logic so the monitor workflow reliably filters itself out.
- Set up Telegram bot credentials and the destination chat ID, then enable the Telegram alert node after testing.

### Customization

Adjust the assessment and report code nodes to change what counts as unhealthy, how many executions are reviewed, and the wording or destination of alert messages.

## Schedule and filter workflows

Starts the monitor on a six-hour schedule, retrieves active workflows from n8n, and filters out the monitoring workflow itself before processing begins.

## Iterate workflow list

Controls the batch loop that sends each workflow through the detailed assessment path and then emits the completed set of assessments for reporting.

## Assess each workflow

For each workflow in the loop, fetches the workflow details, reads the last five executions, and calculates a per-workflow health assessment before returning to the loop.

## Report and alert

Builds the overall health report from all workflow assessments, checks whether any alerts are present, and sends a Telegram notification when needed.

nodes.name: Fetch Active Workflows
nodes.notes: Select/create your own n8n API credential. It needs read access to workflows and executions.

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Executions
nodes.notes: Includes execution details to identify failed nodes; some workflows redact or do not retain them. Lower the sample limit if execution data is large.

nodes.name: Send Telegram Alert
nodes.notes: Configure Telegram credentials and replace chat ID. Then enable this node.
